CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.Electric_Vehicle_Population_Ext_table
(
    [VIN (1-10)] VARCHAR(10),
    County VARCHAR(100),
    City VARCHAR(100),
    State VARCHAR(10),
    [Postal Code] VARCHAR(10),
    [Model Year] INT,
    Make VARCHAR(100),
    Model VARCHAR(100),
    [Electric Vehicle Type] VARCHAR(100),
    [Clean Alternative Fuel Vehicle (CAFV) Eligibility] VARCHAR(150),
    [Electric Range] INT,
    [Base MSRP] INT,
    [Legislative District] INT,
    [DOL Vehicle ID] BIGINT,
    [Vehicle Location] VARCHAR(200),
    [Electric Utility] VARCHAR(200),
    [2020 Census Tract] BIGINT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'inputdata/Electric_Vehicle_Population_Data_1.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source_practice,
    FILE_FORMAT = external_csv_file
);

DROP EXTERNAL TABLE  dbo.Electric_Vehicle_Population_Ext_table;


SELECT * FROM 
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'inputdata/Electric_Vehicle_Population_Data_1.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source_practice',
    FORMAT='CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;










CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.covid_tracking_ext_table2
(
    date DATE,
    state VARCHAR(10),
    positive BIGINT,
    negative BIGINT,
    pending BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCurrently BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCumulative BIGINT,
    inIcuCurrently BIGINT,
    inIcuCumulative BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCurrently BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCumulative BIGINT,
    recovered BIGINT,
    death BIGINT,
    totalTestResults BIGINT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'inputdata/covid_tracking2.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source_practice,
    FILE_FORMAT = external_parquet_file
);



SELECT * FROM 
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'inputdata/covid_tracking2.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source_practice',
    FORMAT='PARQUET'
) AS QUERY1;
